mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a 5-day decline in S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and retail sales (HOUST < 1650k and RSAFS < 540000M) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which is associated with negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls exceeding 50,000 indicates weakening labor market momentum, which is followed by negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as corporate hiring slowdowns signal reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO MoM < -0.5%) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL MoM > 2.5%) signal stagflation, which is followed by negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors flee equities.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST < 1600k units), consumer spending and business investment decline, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as the market prices in a prolonged economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, which is associated with positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of periods with rising INDPRO, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
